name: premium
label: Premium
css: .style-premium { background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--text, #111827); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 64px; box-sizing: border-box; overflow: hidden; } .style-premium::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0%, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.06; pointer-events: none; } .style-premium .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--text, #111827); margin: 0; z-index: 1; max-width: 90%; word-wrap: break-word; } .style-premium .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--text, #111827); margin: 0; z-index: 1; max-width: 85%; } .style-premium .step { position: absolute; top: 64px; right: 64px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; color: var(--text, #111827); opacity: 0.08; z-index: 0; } .style-premium .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 64px; left: 64px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text, #111827); letter-spacing: 0.05em; z-index: 1; } .slide-code.style-premium { background: #0F172A; color: #E2E8F0; } .slide-code.style-premium .hook { color: #F1F5F9; } .slide-code.style-premium .text { color: #CBD5E1; } .slide-code.style-premium .step { color: #E2E8F0; opacity: 0.12; } .slide-code.style-premium .brand { color: #94A3B8; } .slide-code.style-premium::before { background: radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0%, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.1; } .slide-insight.style-premium { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #111827 0%, #1F2937 100%); color: #F3F4F6; } .slide-insight.style-premium .hook { color: #F9FAFB; } .slide-insight.style-premium .text { color: #F3F4F6; } .slide-insight.style-premium .insight-text { font-size: 44px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: #FFFFFF; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6), var(--secondary, #8B5CF6)); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text; margin: 24px 0; z-index: 1; } .slide-insight.style-premium .step { color: #F3F4F6; opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-premium .brand { color: #D1D5DB; } .slide-insight.style-premium::before { background: radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0%, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.12; }
